accounting.same_image: ENC_coded vs ENC_ignore and LC_use / LC_R / LC_A vs LC_ignore: same image, same features / front end; differences are decoding-information effects
accounting.brightness: coded2 vs plain (common budget) and coded_high vs coded_low (peak-matched): different images and peaks -> pattern + brightness, not a pure code effect
accounting.scheme: V5 45 deg uncoded vs 0 deg coded R: different pattern AND decoder parameters -> scheme comparison only

questions.information_gain: coded2 images, ENC_coded - ENC_ignore on the same image, sigma 25 / 30 / 35
questions.brightness_cost: coded2 vs plain in main_common_budget (same sigma, same phase / realisation) and coded_high vs coded_low (sigma 30)

section4.statistics: paired diff per phase vs S0 (same surface, baseline, sigma, phase) -> median of 4 phases per block -> equal-weight median over complete blocks; bootstrap seed 20261011; interval only with >= 8 blocks; layouts shared by strategies = one decode
section4.denominators: generation attempts / acceptance (SPAT-03, geometry independent), unique layouts, images, decodes, strategy views reported separately
